services.desc: Learning to paddle on a stand-up paddle board has never been easier with Covewater’s Intro SUP Paddling Lesson. Our proven method will give you the knowledge and confidence to get on the water today. We remember what it was like to learn for the first time, so we focus on recreating that same amazing sensation for you. Our plan not only ensures you enjoy the experience to the fullest but also equips you with the tools to improve every time you go out. For some of us, the goal is to go faster, paddle farther, catch more or bigger waves with ease, or even compete in races. Achieving these goals starts with mastering the correct paddling technique. services.name: Surfing Lessons
services.desc: We’ve all seen the incredible videos of surfers on foils catching endless waves and then 'pumping' back out to catch the next wave without even paddling. Learning to surf on a foil takes the exhilaration of surfing to the next level. The ability to pump back out and catch a wave immediately after the previous one is a dream come true for every surfer. Our Pumping and Surfing Hydrofoil Lesson makes that dream a reality. Using our specialized boat, we train you to ride waves on a foil and master the art of pumping, enabling you to catch wave after wave.
